messages:
zara: Tiny idea  'Pick'em & Pints' for Sunday  5-ish props, $4 entry, winner gets the pints jar and bragging rights. Who's in? :beer: :soccer:

leo: In. Quick question: are we doing live picks or spreadsheet?

maria: Spreadsheet is easiest. Also pre-game picks lock 10 minutes before kickoff.

zara: Yep spreadsheet. Rules: 2 pts per correct prop, 1 bonus for exact final score. Props: first scorer, longest play over/under 25 yards, team with most corners, whether theres a 40+ yd FG, and coin flip for OT.

noah: Love that combo. Can we add a tiny GIF-forfeit? Loser posts a wholesome victory GIF for a week. SFW only.

rebecca: GIF-forfeit accepted. Also can we limit entries to office staff only? Don't want randos.

zara: Office-only yes. $4 Venmo @zara or cash at table. Spreadsheet link after this thread.

leo: @reminder-bot can you schedule a 15m final reminder to lock picks Sunday?

reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Pick'em & Pints  picks lock in 15 minutes" on 2026-04-19 14:45 PT. Will ping #random and participants.

maria: Tiny scoring edge-case: if a prop is undone (e.g., game canceled), everyone gets 0 for that prop. Agree?

zara: Agreed. Also ties split the pot. If tie for top, split evenly; if exact tie and odd cents, extra cent goes to the person who hosted last year. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

noah: Venmoed. Spreadsheet?

zara: Posted: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/pickem-pints (DMing access). Columns: name, venmo_txn, prop1..prop5, tiebreaker(final score), notes.

rebecca: Small welcome note: please keep cheering inside building low-volume after 9pm. Also someone remind me how to make nacho cheese in the office microwave without chaos.

leo: Quick tip: heat in 20s bursts, stir between. You're welcome.

zara: Alright final checklist: $4, spreadsheet, picks lock 10m before kickoff, GIF-forfeit for loser, office-only. Closing thread unless objections. Good luck and may the least predictable person win. :tada:
